Mystic.description: Imbued with clear memories of past lives' magical practices.

features.name: Mystic Samsaran
features.tldr: You can pick up an additional arcane or divine cantrip from your past studies.

Resilient.description: Carrying physical fortitude carried over from strenuous previous incarnations.

features.name: Resilient Samsaran
features.tldr: You gain bonuses on saving throws against curses and magical afflictions.
